evidence.evidence_text: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have driven growing interest in LLM-based agents for complex planning tasks.
Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have driven growing interest in LLM-based agents for complex planning tasks.
To avoid costly agent training, many studies adopted memory mechanism that enhances LLM with offline experiences or online trajectory analysis.
When facing environmental anomalies, the LLM grounds the current situation into fine-grained key information, enabling flexible self-QA reflection and plan correction.
We propose Coarse-to-Fine Grounded Memory (CFGM), a novel framework that grounds coarse-to-fine memories with LLM, thereby fully leverage them for flexible adaptation to diverse scenarios.
